description: This file contains Hebrew localization strings for the Select2 jQuery plugin, version 4.0.6-rc.1. It defines Hebrew translations for various UI messages used in the plugin.

methods.name: errorLoading
methods.description: Returns Hebrew message for error loading results.

methods.name: inputTooLong
methods.description: Returns message indicating how many characters to delete when input exceeds maximum.

methods.name: inputTooShort
methods.description: Returns message indicating how many characters to enter when input is below minimum.

methods.name: loadingMore
methods.description: Returns Hebrew message indicating more results are loading.

methods.name: maximumSelected
methods.description: Returns message indicating maximum number of items user can select.

methods.name: noResults
methods.description: Returns Hebrew message indicating no search results found.

methods.name: searching
methods.description: Returns Hebrew message indicating that search is in progress.
